script:
// @ts-nocheck // Generated from tools/fun/name-generator.html // Source SHA-256: a9e8e07c6147046d6e4e127f31913527f778e7aa64f127d30ac87edbf7261b74 // MIT: Copyright (c) 2025 chico; 2025-2026 chicogong const data = { chinese: { surnames: [ "王", "李", "张", "刘", "陈", "杨", "赵", "黄", "周", "吴", "徐", "孙", "胡", "朱", "高", "林", "何", "郭", "马", "罗" ], male: [ "伟", "强", "磊", "洋", "勇", "军", "杰", "涛", "明", "超", "鹏", "辉", "龙", "华", "浩", "博", "宇", "翔", "峰", "威" ], female: [ "芳", "娜", "静", "婷", "敏", "丽", "艳", "红", "梅", "燕", "霞", "琳", "玲", "雪", "娟", "萍", "倩", "欣", "颖", "蕾" ] }, english: { male: [ "James", "John", "Robert", "Michael", "William", "David", "Richard", "Joseph", "Thomas", "Charles", "Daniel", "Matthew", "Anthony", "Mark", "Donald", "Steven", "Paul", "Andrew", "Joshua", "Kenneth" ], female: [ "Mary", "Patricia", "Jennifer", "Linda", "Barbara", "Elizabeth", "Susan", "Jessica", "Sarah", "Karen", "Nancy", "Lisa", "Betty", "Margaret", "Sandra", "Ashley", "Dorothy", "Kimberly", "Emily", "Donna" ], surnames: [ "Smith", "Johnson", "Williams", "Brown", "Jones", "Garcia", "Miller", "Davis", "Rodriguez", "Martinez", "Hernandez", "Lopez", "Gonzalez", "Wilson", "Anderson", "Thomas", "Taylor", "Moore", "Jackson", "Martin" ] }, japanese: { surnames: [ "佐藤", "鈴木", "高橋", "田中", "渡辺", "伊藤", "山本", "中村", "小林", "加藤", "吉田", "山田", "佐々木", "山口", "松本", "井上", "木村", "林", "清水", "山崎" ], male: [ "太郎", "一郎", "健太", "大輔", "翔太", "拓也", "達也", "直樹", "雄大", "和也", "亮", "翔", "蓮", "大翔", "悠真", "陽翔", "蒼", "律", "朝陽", "湊" ], female: [ "花子", "美咲", "陽菜", "結衣", "葵", "咲良", "凛", "楓", "莉子", "芽依", "彩乃", "優奈", "愛", "美優", "心春", "杏", "紬", "結菜", "詩", "桜" ] } }; function random(arr) { return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)]; } function generateName(lang, gender) { const d = data[lang]; const g = gender === "random" ? (Math.random() > 0.5 ? "male" : "female") : gender; if (lang === "chinese") { return random(d.surnames) + random(d[g]) + (Math.random() > 0.5 ? random(d[g]) : ""); } else if (lang === "english") { return random(d[g]) + " " + random(d.surnames); } else { return random(d.surnames) + " " + random(d[g]); } } function generate() { const lang = document.getElementById("language").value; const gender = document.getElementById("gender").value; const count = Math.min(20, Math.max(1, parseInt(document.getElementById("count").value) || 5)); const names = []; for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { names.push(generateName(lang, gender)); } document.getElementById("results").innerHTML = names .map((name) => `
${name}
`) .join(""); } generate(); // Theme toggle function toggleTheme() { const html = document.documentElement; const currentTheme = html.getAttribute("data-theme"); const newTheme = currentTheme === "light" ? "dark" : "light"; html.setAttribute("data-theme", newTheme); document.getElementById("theme-icon").textContent = newTheme === "light" ? "☀️" : "🌙"; localStorage.setItem("theme", newTheme); } // Load saved theme const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme") || "dark"; if (savedTheme === "light") { document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", "light"); document.getElementById("theme-icon").textContent = "☀️"; }
